description: A candlelit interior painted in oil. A man in dark clothing, seen mostly in shadow at the right, holds a swaddled newborn in cream cloth with a magenta velvet cloth; the baby's face is visible with eyes closed. Behind them is a carved dark wooden high-backed chair, and on the left a brass candlestick with a lit pink candle stands on a rough wooden table. Above the chair hangs a dark blue bicorne hat with a small metal cockade, against a pale blue stone wall. A small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner; there is no other text, frame or border.
reason: The painting shows a newborn baby being held, but this is a birth card and the picture must show Napoleon as an adult in his active years. Repaint the scene with an adult Napoleon, or a clearly adult figure in a bicorne, and keep the candlelit room.
